message.text: Checking store/memo.go around DeleteMemo to identify dependent records deleted before the memo row.

The store layer deletes memo_relation records where this memo is the source or target. It also deletes attachments linked to this memo. Then it deletes the memo row itself.

Checking whether the API layer or database cascades also delete memo shares, reactions, or inbox items before the memo row itself.

args.command: echo '==== API DeleteMemo ===='; grep -n -A 80 "func (s \*APIV1Service) DeleteMemo" /bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go | head -90; echo '==== dialect DeleteMemo ===='; grep -n -A 25 "func (d \*DB) DeleteMemo" /bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/memo.go /bench/repo/store/db/postgres/memo.go /bench/repo/store/db/mysql/memo.go

message.text: In store/memo.go, DeleteMemo removes memo_relation records and attachments before deleting the memo row itself.

q16.
memo_relation records (as source or target), attachments

`Store.DeleteMemo` in `store/memo.go` deletes `memo_relation` rows where the memo is `memo_id` or `related_memo_id`, then deletes linked attachments via `DeleteAttachment`, then deletes the memo row. The API handler in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` deletes comment memos first, but that happens above the store cleanup.
